faq.q: Can I make a YouTube Shorts ad from one product photo?
faq.a: Yes. Upload one clear picture, describe one action, and choose 6, 10, 15 or 30 seconds. The credit cost shows before the job starts.

faq.q: Is this the same as a skippable in-stream ad?
faq.a: No. This page is for a tall Shorts file. A 16:9 in-stream ad is a separate wide job. Do not crop one and call it the other.

faq.q: Do Shorts ads need a creator or narration?
faq.a: No. You do not book a creator. The file has no voice track, music or captions. If a person appears, that presenter is generated, not a real customer.

faq.q: What does a Short cost in credits?
faq.a: A still costs 24 credits. A clip costs 24, 40, 60 or 120 credits for 6, 10, 15 or 30 seconds, and the price shows before you start. If a job fails, those credits return on their own.
Yes. You write the action, choose the length, and can run another job with a different scene. There is no automatic hook test.

faq.q: Are AI clips allowed in YouTube ads?
faq.a: Follow Google's current ad-review and disclosure rules on the day you publish. We do not submit the ad, and we do not guarantee approval.

faq.q: Can the same tall file run somewhere else?
faq.a: A 9:16 file can be tried in other tall placements, but preview it in each player. Controls differ, and a pass in one does not mean a pass in another.
Use [social media ad sizes](/guides/ad-sizes-by-platform) before you export, and keep the product clear of the player controls.
